prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, apex siren physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail auburn hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of ultra-thin glossy crimson PVC, made of two small triangle cups held by a single strap over her left shoulder, her right shoulder and right arm bare, joined to the bottom by one narrow diagonal strap of the same PVC that runs from the cups across her stomach to her right hip, a short closed zipper running along the diagonal strap with the zipper teeth visible, her waist sides, her flanks, her stomach and the skin around the straps bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the PVC shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin PVC molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, the dip of her navel, her ribs, her hip bones and the roundness of her bust and hips, the single diagonal strap pressing lightly into her skin, the zipper teeth glinting along it, soft liquid highlights sliding over each contour. Pose: standing just behind the foreground landmark with one hand resting on top of it, one leg crossed in front of the other, the other arm hanging relaxed at her side, chin lifted, her legs fully in view — most extreme apex siren silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy crimson PVC, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy crimson PVC with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.

Background: a real famous place photographed at true scale, a real container terminal with a huge container ship moored at the quay, stacks of colorful shipping containers and tall blue gantry cranes placed in the foreground close to the camera at the bottom centre of the frame, rising only to the height of her waist and thighs, tiny trucks, tiny forklifts and tiny dock workers around its base at their real size appearing as small as ants; she is a colossal giant standing just behind and slightly to one side of the foreground landmark, so that it overlaps only part of her legs and clearly shows how much taller than it she is, her towering heels planted on the concrete quay, a soft hazy dusk sky behind her, the whole place clearly visible and in focus, lit by soft dusk light with the port floodlights glowing and gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at knee height, the famous foreground landmark large at the bottom centre of the frame and she standing just behind it, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the real people, vehicles and trees around her ankles shown at their true size so her colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
